title: C adapter test suite
description: Session 3 of the C adapter arc. Comprehensive test suite for the C parser, adapter, import resolver, and integration with the full pipeline.

acceptance_criteria.text: Smoke parse test: simple C file parses with parsed_ok=true and correct symbol count
Symbol extraction test: function, struct, enum, typedef, function-like macro, value macro, global var — all kinds correct with expected qualified names, visibility, signatures
Header guard filtering test: #define FOO_H excluded, #define MAX_SIZE 1024 included
Reference classification test: call→Call, field access→FieldAccess, type use→TypeUse
Import edge test: #include "foo.h" and #include <stdio.h> both produce ExtractedImport with correct raw_path
Complexity test: function with if/for/while/switch/goto — cyclomatic and cognitive scores verified
Language attrs test: static, inline, pointer return/param — JSON attrs verified
Flags test: test file heuristic detection, __attribute__ FFI detection
Import resolution test: quoted includes resolve relative and project-root, angle-bracket stays unresolved
compile_commands.json test: -I paths extracted and used for resolution
All existing tests still pass (cargo test full suite)
Adapter integration: CAdapter registered, FCA attributes flow through, effect patterns match

execution_record: Created tests/parse_c_test.rs with 22 integration tests covering all acceptance criteria. Widened visibility of resolve_quoted_include, parse_compile_commands, and CompileCommands in c_imports.rs (3 lines each, struct + 2 functions) to enable import resolution testing without going through the DB. Four tests needed fixes during development: preprocessor-only source strings caused parsed_ok=false (added dummy functions), header guard test needed flat defines rather than #ifndef/#endif wrapping (tree-sitter nests children under preproc_ifdef), and struct Point as a parameter type was suppressed by is_definition_name (switched to typedef'd Point for TypeUse ref test).
